name: Find Tutorial Videos
description: Search YouTube for helpful tutorial videos when the user wants to watch how something is done, or when a visual demonstration would help more than text instructions
prompt: Videos are attached automatically by the system — do NOT list video titles or URLs. Just give a brief summary of the topic (2-3 sentences max) and say 'I found some videos below that show how to do this.' Then give your own quick 1-3 step summary of the task.
